paite: Israel naupang ahih lai in, amah ka it a, Aigupta a kipan ka tapa ka samkhia hi.
heading: Helhatte Tung A Pathian Itna
english: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

paite: Amaute asap chiang un, amau a kipan apai gamla sem ua, Baal kiang ah akithoih ua, lim bawltawmte kiang ah gimlim ahal uhi.
english: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.

paite: Hinapi in Ephraim pai ka kisinsak a; ka ban in amau ka pom a; himahleh amaute'n ka hihdam ahih lam uh athei kei uhi.
english: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.

paite: Mihing khaute leh itna gui in amau ka kai a, amaute a ding in amuk tung uleh amuk nuai ua kibat hakkol ka lakkhiaksak a, ama uah an ka lui hi.
english: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.

paite: Aigupta gam ah akik nawn kei ding a; himahleh Assuria mi akumpipa ahi ding, kik nawn anial ziak un.
english: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.

paite: Huan akhopite tung ah namsau lik in a-om dia, asiktawnte ahul in, anegai ding, athuhilhte uh ngei ziak in.
english: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.

paite: Huchi in ka mite'n kei a kipan nungtawn atum tinten uh; amah tungsang a ompa sam mah le uh, kuamah in amah aliansak kei ding uh.
english: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.

paite: Ephraim, bangchi in ka hon tawpsan dia? Israel, bangchi in ka hon tankhe dia? Admah bang in bangchi in ka hon bawl dia? Zeboim bang in bangchi in ka hon koih dia? Ka sung ah ka lungtang akilumlet a, ka lainatnate toh akuangkhawm hi.
english: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.

paite: Ka hehna mahmah ka suahkhesak kei ding a, Ephraim hihse ding in ka kihei kei ding; mihing hilou in, Pathian ka hi a, nang lak a Mi Siangthou, khopi sung ah ka lut kei ding hi.
english: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.

paite: Amau TOUPA deihdan in a-om ding ua; amah humpinelkai bang in ahumham ding a, amah ahumham chiang in, tumlam a kipan tate ling kawm in ahong pai ding uhi.
english: They will walk after Yahweh, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.

paite: Aigupta a kipan a vasa bang in ling kawm in ahong pai ding ua, Assuria gam a kipan a vakhu bang in; a-innte ua teng ding in amau ka bawl ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ephraim in zuauthu in leh Israel inkuan in khemna in kei ahon umsuak a; himahleh Judah bel Pathian toh vai ahawm lai a, misiangthoute toh aginom lai hi.
heading: Judah Leh Israel Mohna
english: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.
